Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 19-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: HUM 3022/HUM_3022 ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT  
  (SPL: COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING / INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY)  
  ESSENTIALS OF MANAGEMENT [HUM 3022]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               What are the principles of Henri Fayol? Explain any four of its importance in the system approach of (4)  
  management.  
1B)               What is Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)? Explain the role of drivers of CSR in detail.           (3)  
1C)               The Samsung group is a large Korean conglomerate that focuses on electronics and financial             (3)  
  services. In the past, many Korean companies encountered difficulties because they diversified into  
  unrelated fields. In its new approach to management, Samsung tries to avoid the pitfalls of other  
  companies. At the turn of the century, Samsung initiated a policy designed to make the company a  
  leader in its field, competing against firms such as Sony of Japan. The company is driven by its  
  values and its philosophy. Samsung realizes the importance of its people and the use of latest  
  technologies for achieving success in the marketplace. At the same time, it is aware of the  
  responsibility to contribute to society not only in Korea, but also worldwide. Chairman Lee Kun-Hee  
  laid the groundwork for a new approach to management that considers defects a crime. Quality,  
  superior products and excellent customer service are considered key factors for success in the very  
  competitive environment that has been dominated by Japanese firms. With its "digital management"  
  approach, Samsung attempts to exploit the opportunities created by the information age  
  technologies.  
  Samsung's values, philosophy and policies as well as its goal of becoming a global leader in its field  
  have attracted many Korean students. Samsung will use the talents of these young people, to  
  successfully compete in the global environment.  
  Analyse this case in terms of Porter's Generic strategies.  
2A)               What are the various types of plans used in an organization? Briefly describe any four of them.        (4)  
2B)               Explain the nature and purpose of organizing function in management. Also discuss the steps in         (3)  
  organizing with a suitable representation.  
2C)               Propose a scheme of departmentation for an MNC with a field network of sales all over the country. (3)  
  Discuss its merits and limitations.  
3A)               As the founder of a small manufacturing company producing steel bolts, you are considering             (3)  
  adopting a Line Organizational structure. Apply the features of a line organization to explain how  
  authority, communication, and decision-making would function in your company to ensure  
  operational efficiency and draw the organizational chart.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)               You are the HR manager at an esteemed Nestlé (Food and beverages) with its production factory in (3)  
  Bengaluru. You need to create a comprehensive job specification on 6 factors for a Graduate  
  Engineer Trainee (GET) reporting to the Production & Maintenance Manager (Technical) at their  
  Bengaluru factory.  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3C)   Lenskart, India's leading eyewear retailer, wants to understand why some of its store employees        (4)  
  report high job satisfaction while others feel disengaged despite similar working conditions. As an  
  HR analyst, analyze 4 factors each for how Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory can help Lenskart, and  
  explain how addressing these factors can improve overall employee morale and productivity.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)   You are the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) for Tata Motors - one of India's largest              (3)  
  automotive manufacturers, and your task is to pick 3 each of the best internal sources and external  
  sources for the next recruitment drive. You need to justify your selections to the Board of Directors.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)   You are the founder of a 'Tech Startup' that leverages technology to develop innovative products or (3)  
  services, often aiming for rapid growth and scalability. You would be recruiting new employees  
  shortly and thus researching the Current Trends. Elaborate on 3 current trends in Training &  
  Development that you will be considering for your startup.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)   Quote the lines from the Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Project Scenarios to identify and explain (4)  
  the different Leadership Styles incorporated based on use of authority.  
  In the planning phase of a new software solution, the same manager conducts brainstorming  
  sessions, encourages team members to share ideas, and collectively decides on the technology  
  stack and workflow.  
  Once the project enters the development stage, experienced developers are given autonomy to  
  choose coding practices and manage their schedules, with minimal supervision, trusting their  
  expertise.  
  During a critical client deadline, the project manager takes full control, assigns tasks without  
  discussion, and enforces strict timelines to ensure timely delivery and facilitate quick decisions  
  without team input.  
  In the testing phase, senior QA engineers are given full freedom to choose tools, create test cases,  
  and schedule their work, with minimal managerial intervention.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5A)   As the HR manager at PhonePe, a leading digital payments and financial services platform in India, (3)  
  apply your understanding of induction (3 factors) and orientation (3 factors) to design a program for  
  newly recruited employees. Explain how your program will help newcomers quickly adapt to the  
  company's culture, policies, and job responsibilities while enhancing their engagement and  
  productivity.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)   Apply your understanding of the communication process to explain how information flows in an           (3)  
  organization. Illustrate your answer with a neat block diagram.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)   Analyze how four types of standards can be applied during the managerial function - control in a (4)  
  company like Micromax (an Indian consumer electronics company known for affordable  
  smartphones and mobile devices) to evaluate performance and improve operational efficiency.  
  Explain the impact of each standard on decision-making and organizational outcomes for Micromax.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  -----End-----
